The new calendar includes more than 500 events, highlighted by over 80 international tournaments and championships. Launched in cooperation with the Dubai Digital Authority, the calendar will be freely accessible to all users of the ‘DubaiNow’ application, which will offer detailed information related to all sporting events held in Dubai.
